name: multiplication to vector addition
formula: nu(mn)=nu(m)+nu(n)
recovery: recover m and n only if the summands are separately retained

name: divisibility to coordinate order
formula: d|n iff nu(d)<=nu(n) coordinatewise
recovery: the relation alone does not recover either vector

name: support projection
formula: a_p maps to 1_{a_p>0}
recovery: requires all positive heights as side information

name: forget prime labels
formula: (p,a_p) maps to multiset of a_p
recovery: requires a bijection between heights and prime labels

name: sum heights
formula: a maps to sum_p a_p
recovery: not possible without labeled composition data

name: count active coordinates
formula: S maps to |S|
recovery: not possible without prime labels

name: logarithmic linear functional
formula: a maps to sum_p a_p log p
recovery: unique factorization recovers n, then nu(n)

name: vector to divisor box
formula: a maps to prod_p [0,a_p] intersect Z
recovery: upper corner and labels recover nu(n)

name: divisor-box cardinality
formula: B maps to product_p(a_p+1)
recovery: requires labeled side lengths

name: face incidence to boundary count
formula: labeled boundary set maps to its cardinality
recovery: requires the labeled boundary subset

name: box to margin-interior weight
formula: B(n) maps to product_p max(a_p-2r+1,0)
recovery: count alone does not recover side lengths

name: minimum-height threshold
formula: a maps to 1 if every active a_p>=k
recovery: only lower bounds on active heights survive

name: Boolean support encoding
formula: S maps to product_{p in S}p
recovery: factor rad(n) to recover S

name: valuation vector to residue class
formula: a maps to product_p p^{a_p} mod q
recovery: requires enough labeled arithmetic data beyond one residue

name: character phase projection
formula: a maps to product_p chi(p)^{a_p}
recovery: all character coefficients recover a function on reduced residue classes, not the original vector

name: full finite Fourier transform
formula: F(a) maps to sum_a F(a) conjugate(chi(a))
recovery: inverse character transform

name: discard character phases
formula: c_chi maps to sum_{chi ne chi0}|c_chi|^2
recovery: not possible without phases and individual magnitudes

name: valuation truncation
formula: retain only coordinates and depths visible below D
recovery: requires invisible primes and deep layers

name: population pushforward
formula: profiles map to A_d=sum_n w_n1_{d|n}
recovery: only modulo the measurement-kernel nullspace

name: factorization decomposition
formula: nu(n) maps to pairs beta+gamma=nu(n)
recovery: the common sum recovers nu(n)

name: two-block projection
formula: partition factor coordinates into two interacting blocks
recovery: higher-order interaction data are omitted

name: restrict observable to one prime axis
formula: f maps to sequence a mapsto f(p^a)
recovery: recovers a multiplicative f only if primewise independence and all local germs are retained

name: local germ to Bell series
formula: f(p^a) maps to sum_a f(p^a)y^a
recovery: coefficient extraction

name: assemble local factors
formula: local factors map to product_p F_p(p^{-s})
recovery: local factors recoverable where Euler product identity is valid
ant_interface: Euler products; convergence and continuation certificates required
